# DSA.viz.co

> Master Data Structures & Algorithms by seeing how they think. Step through 1,500+ classic algorithmic problems frame by frame with live pointer animations, curated DSA roadmaps, Socratic AI coaching, handwritten PDF note synthesis, and sandboxed C++20/Java/Python execution.

## Core Interactive Applications

- [Interactive Algorithm Visualizer](https://dsa.viz.co/problem/two-sum): Frame-by-frame execution with live pointer mutations, recursion trees, 2D DP grids, and invariant audits.
- [Curated DSA Study Sheets](https://dsa.viz.co/sheets): Structured roadmaps for Striver A2Z, Blind 75, NeetCode 150, Grind 75, and Love Babbar 450 with progress tracking.
- [AI Learning Whiteboard](https://dsa.viz.co/ai-learning): Full-screen Excalidraw whiteboard paired with an interactive Socratic AI co-teacher for live visual simulations.
- [FAANG Mock Interview Simulator](https://dsa.viz.co/live-interview): 3-Tier proctored coding interview room with real-time speech-to-text, whiteboard collaboration, and rubric evaluation.
- [AI Notes Engine](https://dsa.viz.co/ai-notes): Universal notebook aggregator that synthesizes algorithm state cards, sketches, and solutions into handwritten-style A4 PDFs.
- [Online Multi-Language Compiler](https://dsa.viz.co/compiler): Sandboxed code runner with support for C++20 (GCC 14), C17, Java 21, and Python 3.12 with stdin/stdout streams.
- [Algorithm Invariant Playground](https://dsa.viz.co/playground): Freeform custom laboratory to stress-test arbitrary algorithms against edge-case data structures.
- [Algorithmic Telemetry & Profile](https://dsa.viz.co/profile): Account dashboard with problem velocity analytics, connected LeetCode/GitHub links, and GDPR data export.

## Problem Catalog & Reference

- [Problem Catalog](https://dsa.viz.co/problems): Searchable database of 1,500+ LeetCode problems categorized by topic, difficulty, and company tags.
- [Two Sum Visualizer](https://dsa.viz.co/problem/two-sum): Classic hash map lookup and complement tracking visualization.
- [Trapping Rain Water Visualizer](https://dsa.viz.co/problem/trapping-rain-water): Two-pointer elevation array and trapped water volume simulation.
- [Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters](https://dsa.viz.co/problem/longest-substring-without-repeating-characters): Dynamic sliding window pointer expansion and contract simulation.

## Optional

- [Sitemap Index](https://dsa.viz.co/sitemap.xml): Complete XML sitemap of all canonical problem and roadmap pages.
- [Robots Directives](https://dsa.viz.co/robots.txt): Crawler rules and accessibility definitions for search indexing bots.
- [Terms & Fair Use Notice](https://dsa.viz.co/terms): 17 U.S.C. § 107 nominative and educational fair use legal disclaimers.
- [Privacy Policy](https://dsa.viz.co/privacy): Security, encryption, and zero-PII storage policy.
